description: Compatibility entry point for PEP textbook sequencing. The original partial current-series seed has been superseded by a verified 12-volume revised-series sequence. Legacy material remains isolated for historical comparison only.

limits: Subsection/example/page-level mapping is a separate research layer.
Locality-specific adoption is not inferred from the series table.
PEP is one textbook system and must not be presented as the only textbook used in China.

database_behavior.default_ui: Use the verified revised-series sequence when PEP is selected.
database_behavior.legacy_ui: Show legacy records only when a previous-edition/historical view is explicitly selected.
database_behavior.national_curriculum_ui: Keep PEP textbook placement separate from the national 2022 learning-stage requirements.
